## Page and competency

Link the page and name the relevant competency ID.

## Problem and proposed improvement

Describe the practical gap or unclear instruction. Use fictional examples.

## Sources and scope

Include an original source, jurisdiction, and date checked when factual guidance changes.

## Evidence of usefulness

Explain what the learner would be able to do better and how the task could assess it. Do not include personal, financial, health, account, or identity records.
